NFA-F: after the return to the low-rate step it delivered only ≈138 mAh g^− 1[4], against an initial capacity of ≈190 mAh g^− 1[5], a loss the paper gives as ≈27%[6]. The paper concludes that NFA-A was the most stable variant under these test conditions.
